Identical bytes must produce identical observable facts even when a producer refuses later. Self-declared subcounts and location membership cannot prove missing actual subtests, complete traversal or original frame order. Those limits are explicit in the API results, scenarios and readiness gates; no matching-byte result authenticates runtime behavior or grants COMPONENT_MODEL_ONLY.

They account for pre-result/assert/mock/helper formatting, unknown effects, original EOF/error/closure and observer chunk order without inventing cross-stream write order.
